programs.title: K9 PD With Jim Belushi
programs.desc: Fresh out of the academy, rookie K9 Carrier gets the call, but can he score his first apprehension?; in a pounding downpour, K9 Flash stays locked on the scent, tracking a suspect who bolted even after being tasered.

programs.title: K9 PD With Jim Belushi
programs.desc: As the sun goes down in a quiet farm town, K9 Rico is deployed to track down a man accused of strangling his neighbor; meanwhile, K9 Clooney springs into action when a desperate suspect makes a bold, shocking move-stealing a police cruiser in a last-ditch attempt to escape; K9 Murphy teams up with the aviation unit, combining forces in a relentless search for a suspect who fled after leading officers on a nearly 100-mile chase.

programs.title: K9 PD With Jim Belushi
programs.desc: Every search has a conclusion: whether it's finding a missing person or chasing a suspect on the run, a police K9 makes sure it ends with answers; K9 Pandora wastes no time bringing relief to a desperate family looking for a family member; K9s Jet and Cheney tag-team a fugitive who tears up the roadway and refuses to stop; K9 Karma shuts down a belligerent man fighting arrest; and K-9 Endo follows the scent straight to a dumpster.

programs.title: K9 PD With Jim Belushi
programs.desc: When a suspect makes it clear he's not stopping for anyone, it's up to K9 Murphy's speed and determination to bring the chase to an end; K9 Bear's bomb-detection training is suddenly put to the test when explosives detonate in the middle of the night; after eluding police for weeks, a naked fugitive is on the run again; K9 Eddie is called in, and the pursuit ends exactly as his training predicts; and K9 Red barrels into action after a suspect crashes into a police cruiser and then tears off.

programs.title: K9 PD With Jim Belushi
programs.desc: Along with FBI and Department of Correction agents, K-9 Eddie tracks down a suspect with an active warrant. Meanwhile, K-9 Jax hits the ground running, searching for a suspect accused of stealing a pickup truck. K-9 Dundee deploys in pursuit of a suspect who crashed a van straight into a fitness center, causing major damage. And despite a high-tech surveillance system in place, K-9 Koda is called in to do what technology can't: follow the scent and find the suspect.

programs.title: K9 PD With Jim Belushi
programs.desc: K9 Tipster comes face-to-face with a familiar face, a repeat offender who remembers their last encounter all too well; K9 Murphy, a battle-tested German Shepherd with over a hundred deployments under his collar, is called in when a crash scene turns into a manhunt; meanwhile, K9 Murph tears into action, tracking down a suspect whose joyride breaks one too many laws; and K9 Guapo, arguably the most handsome dog on the force, proves he's more than just good looks.
